whatsappMessage:
Hi Team 9to9,

I noticed your store has incredible 4.2★ reviews from over 1,700 customers in Fraser Road Area, Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile ordering and product showcase page.

Maine aapke 9to9 store ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp order inquiries, product categories, aur store location integration ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/9to9

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript:
Hi Team 9to9, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke store (9to9) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya?

*(If checked)*: Great! We tailored it specifically with mobile-first speed, product category showcases, and direct WhatsApp ordering for your customers in Fraser Road Area, Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga?

*(If not checked)*: No problem at all! Direct live link aapke WhatsApp par hai. Whenever you get 2 minutes ek baar open karke check kariyega—koi commitment nahi hai, just wanted to share the idea and get your feedback.

Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact inventory aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough.
